records.statement: Yamaha's 2020 WR250F owner's service manual schedules road/odometer maintenance at 600 mi (1000 km) or 1 month, 1800 mi (3000 km) or 3 months and 3000 mi (5000 km) or 6 months plus a competition chart (after break-in, every race, every third race, every fifth race, as required), with YAMALUBE engine oil (SAE 10W-40, 10W-50, 15W-40, 20W-40 or 20-W50; API service SG type or higher, JASO standard MA) at 0.73 L (0.77 US qt, 0.64 Imp.qt) per change (0.75 L (0.79 US qt, 0.66 Imp.qt) with filter), 0.93 L (0.98 US qt, 0.82 Imp.qt) of coolant and an NGK LMAR8E-J plug gapped 0.6–0.7 mm (0.024–0.028 in).

records.topic: road-use restrictions, emissions and ECU modes
records.statement: Yamaha's 2020 WR450F owner's service manual states the bike is designed for off-road use only and illegal on public streets, roads or highways, carries a Vehicle Emission Control Information label required by federal law, state law and Environment Canada, and prints no throttle stop, exhaust insert or competition-kit procedure.

values.use restriction (safety information): This motorcycle is designed for off-road use only, therefore, it is illegal to operate it on public streets, roads, or highways, even a dirt or gravel one. Off-road use on public lands may be illegal. Please check local regulations before riding.
values.emissions compliance: The design and manufacture of this Yamaha machine fully comply with the emissions standards for clean air applicable at the date of manufacture; follow the recommended maintenance schedules to maintain them.
values.Vehicle Emission Control Information lab: A label affixed to the vehicle shows specifications related to exhaust emissions as required by federal law, state law and Environment Canada.
values.emission-control maintenance: A separate 'Periodic maintenance chart for the emission control system' (fuel line, spark plug, valve clearance, air filter, breather system, fuel injection idle, exhaust system, engine oil/filter/strainer) applies at 600 mi (1000 km)/1 month, 1800 mi (3000 km)/3 months and 3000 mi (5000 km)/6 months; dealer items are marked *.
values.spark arrester: Equipped with a spark arrester in the muffler: clean it at the 3000 mi (5000 km)/6 month interval (general maintenance chart item 'Spark arrester'); spark arrester bolts M5 x4 at 9 N·m (0.9 kgf·m, 6.6 lb·ft).
values.California Proposition 65 warning: Operating, servicing and maintaining a passenger vehicle or off-road vehicle can expose you to chemicals including engine exhaust, carbon monoxide, phthalates, and lead, which are known to the State of California to cause cancer and birth defects or other reproductive harm (www.P65Warnings.ca.gov/passenger-vehicle).
values.throttle stop / exhaust insert / competi: Not mentioned: no throttle stop screw, exhaust insert/restrictor, competition kit, street-legal/registration or US/California-specific de-restriction procedure is printed in this owner's service manual.

records.notes: Regulatory and restriction statements as printed in the manual (front matter, safety information, identification, maintenance charts, fuel section, back cover). ECU tuning/mode details are in the FI setting record of the same manual.
